sloka: स राज्ञो दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी मुहूर्तं समुपाविशत् ।तस्मिन्नहनि राजर्षिर्निद्रया ऽपहृतो भृशम् ।। ७.५५.१५ ॥
transliteration: sa rājño darśanākāṅkṣī muhūrtaṁ samupāviśat ।tasminnahani rājarṣirnidrayā 'pahṛto bhṛśam ।। 7.55.15 ॥

translations.english: Desirous of seeing the king, Vasiṣṭha sat down for a moment, but on that day, the royal sage was deeply overcome by sleep.
